description: This file defines classes and functions related to XML schema processing and database schema management using ADODB in PHP. It includes classes for database objects, tables, indexes, data, query sets, and schema loading/parsing, along with associated methods for parsing XML schemas, generating SQL, and managing database objects.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: Abstract class representing a generic database object, providing basic methods for start/end XML element processing, platform support checks, prefix retrieval, and field ID extraction.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table for ADOdb's datadict. Handles parsing XML to define fields, indexes, options, and generates SQL for creating/upgrading tables.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a database index, handling index options, fields, creation SQL, and marking for deletion.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Represents data for a database table, processes XML data rows, and generates insert SQL statements.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Handles a set of SQL queries loaded from XML, supports building queries, prefix replacements, and creating final SQL array.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Main class for loading, parsing, and applying XML database schemas, including methods for schema conversion, versioning, and executing SQL.

methods.name: SetUpgradeMethod
methods.description: Sets the upgrade method for schema upgrades ('ALTER', 'REPLACE', 'NONE').

methods.name: ExecuteInline
methods.description: Enables or disables inline execution of generated SQL during schema parsing.

methods.name: ContinueOnError
methods.description: Enables or disables SQL execution continuation if errors occur.

methods.name: ParseSchema
methods.description: Loads an XML schema from a file and generates corresponding SQL queries.

methods.name: ParseSchemaString
methods.description: Parses an XML schema string and produces SQL queries.

methods.name: RemoveSchema
methods.description: Generates SQL to uninstall the schema defined in a file.

methods.name: RemoveSchemaString
methods.description: Generates SQL to uninstall the schema from a string.

methods.name: ExecuteSchema
methods.description: Applies the generated SQL schema to the database, with error handling configuration.

methods.name: PrintSQL
methods.description: Returns the SQL array as a string or array in specified format.

methods.name: SaveSQL
methods.description: Saves the generated SQL queries to a file.

methods.name: create_parser
methods.description: Creates and initializes an XML parser with handlers.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Handles start XML element processing, dispatching to object constructors or methods based on tag.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements during parsing.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles end XML elements, finalizing object parsing.

methods.name: ConvertSchemaString
methods.description: Converts an XML schema string to a different schema version using XSLT.

methods.name: ConvertSchemaFile
methods.description: Converts an XML schema file to a different schema version.

methods.name: SchemaFileVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version of a schema XML file.

methods.name: SchemaStringVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version of a schema XML string.
